summary: Full re-test of Slicer Companion (Iteration 2) after this-session adds: Moonraker connection, filament pricing (price_per_kg + spool_weight_g), estimated_cost in slice, model library strip, iframe 3D viewer on web, compact workspace toolbar. Backend: 21/21 pytest tests PASS (8 new + 13 existing regression). Frontend (390x844 mobile viewport): iframe 3D viewer renders orange cube correctly (no 'WebView not supported' text), model library strip visible (7 chips), Move/Scale/Rotate + Snap all fit inside 390px viewport (Snap right edge = 378px, NOT cut off), Uniform toggle appears when Scale selected, OctoPrint + Moonraker (Klipper) type chips present, moonraker changes host placeholder to include :7125 and API Key label becomes '(optional)', saving a moonraker printer shows 'MR 10.255.255.1:7125' on card, filament card subtitles show '$X/kg', edit modal has 'Price per kg ($)' and 'Spool weight (g)' inputs and price edits persist, Slicer stats row shows 'COST' with $ value (verified $0.02 for cube).

react_native_issues.issue: Persistent console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Non-blocking. Same as Iteration 1. Likely from a library dependency (react-native-svg/react-native-webview), not from app code directly — grep of /app/frontend/app and /app/frontend/src returned no pointerEvents prop usage.

action_items: (Optional) The webview 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' warning still shows in web preview. If it becomes noisy, upgrade the vendor lib that emits it or suppress via LogBox on web.
(Optional / minor) There are now 7 model chips (many duplicate cube.stl uploads accumulated across sessions). Consider adding a 'clear all uploads' or dedupe by filename+size — not blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py test-connection endpoint gracefully handles unreachable Moonraker/OctoPrint hosts (returns 200 with ok:false) — verified.

server.py POST /printers/print correctly branches upload URL by connection.type (moonraker -> /server/files/upload, else /api/files/local) and wraps requests.post in try/except returning ok:false on unreachable host — verified end-to-end.
estimated_cost formula: (filament_grams / 1000) * price_per_kg, rounded to 2dp — matches spec. Returns null when filament_profile_id not supplied — verified.
Startup seed idempotently migrates existing filaments missing price fields via update_many with $exists:false — good.
server.py still uses deprecated @app.on_event startup/shutdown (FastAPI recommends lifespan). Not blocking for MVP.

workspace.tsx web branch uses React.createElement('iframe', { srcDoc: ... }) — renders correctly and receives postMessage via iframeRef.current.contentWindow.postMessage. Verified visually (cube rendered).
workspace.tsx toolRow has flexWrap:'wrap' with a flex:1 spacer pushing Snap right — Snap fits in 390px (measured 378px right edge). No overflow.
seed_data_creation: None persisted. All test data (TEST_PricedFil filament, TEST_MRPrinter printer, TestMRUI printer) was cleaned up after tests. Only regression noise: multiple cube.stl uploads already existed from prior sessions (not created by this run).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new features (Moonraker, filament pricing, estimated_cost, iframe 3D viewer, compact toolbar, MR label, filament price/spool inputs, Slicer Cost stat) are working end-to-end on both backend and web preview. The only persistent minor issue is a react-native-web deprecation warning ('props.pointerEvents') that does NOT come from app source (verified via grep) — it originates from a transitive dependency. Safe to hand back to user.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no defects found in this iteration.
